stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Thor and Natasha fight side by side as founding Avengers when Loki brings the Chitauri army down on New York.
stages.whoA: Black Widow. A fellow founding Avenger who fights beside him in New York.
stages.whoB: Thor. A fellow founding Avenger who fights beside her in New York.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years after the Snap, Natasha holds the remaining Avengers together while Thor falls apart in New Asgard. When she gives her life for the Soul Stone, Thor at first refuses to accept that she is gone.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger who dies for the Soul Stone. He refuses to believe it.
stages.whoB: A fellow Avenger, lost in grief in New Asgard while she holds the team together.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: When Carol Danvers joins the Avengers to go after Thanos, Thor tests her by calling Stormbreaker right past her, and she does not flinch. He likes her at once, and they go to the Garden together, where Thor cuts off Thanos's head.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel. She doesn't flinch when he tests her, and he likes her at once.
stages.whoB: Thor. He tests her with Stormbreaker, then joins her to hunt down Thanos.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Doctor Strange keeps Loki on a watchlist of threats to Earth, and when Loki comes to New York with Thor, Strange traps him falling through a portal for thirty minutes. He then sends both brothers off to find Odin.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange. He leaves Loki falling through a portal for thirty minutes.
stages.whoB: A threat on his watchlist, whom he leaves falling through a portal.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Coulson grew up idolizing Daniel Sousa as the first fallen agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. When the team travels to 1955, they stop the assassination that should have ended Sousa's life, and he joins them.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who idolized him, and whose team saves his life.
stages.whoB: His S.H.I.E.L.D. hero, saved from assassination and now on the team.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Bruce comes to Wakanda with Vision so that Shuri can remove the Mind Stone without killing him. As she studies Vision, she asks Bruce why he and Tony did not build him differently, and he admits they never thought of it.
stages.whoA: The Wakandan genius who works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision.
stages.whoB: One of Vision's makers, who brings him to her to be saved.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: General Hale holds Fitz prisoner at Blue Raven Ridge and means to lock him away for life. Lance Hunter gets in by posing as Fitz's attorney and breaks him out from under her.
stages.whoA: The general holding Fitz prisoner. He breaks Fitz out from under her.
stages.whoB: The man who poses as Fitz's lawyer and breaks him out of her prison.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill tries to stop Loki as he escapes S.H.I.E.L.D.'s collapsing research base with the Tesseract and the agents he has taken over. He gets away and leaves her trapped in the wreckage.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who tries to stop him escaping with the Tesseract.
stages.whoB: The invader who escapes her with the Tesseract and leaves her in the wreckage.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Jeffrey Mace becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and Fitz's boss. Fitz keeps his work with Holden Radcliffe on the android Aida a secret from him.
stages.whoA: The new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., his boss, kept in the dark about Aida.
stages.whoB: One of his agents, who secretly builds Aida with Radcliffe.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Ayo hunts Zemo for killing King T'Chaka, the man she was sworn to protect. After Bucky frees him from prison, she gives Bucky eight hours before the Dora Milaje take Zemo, and in the end they carry him off to the Raft.
stages.whoA: The man who killed her king, T'Chaka. She sees him taken to the Raft.
stages.whoB: The Dora Milaje warrior who hunts him for killing King T'Chaka.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire follows Danny Rand and Colleen Wing to China to face Madame Gao, who threatens to kill both women unless Danny surrenders. Later Claire helps hold Gao prisoner at Colleen's dojo.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader who threatens her life, and whom she later helps hold prisoner.
stages.whoB: Danny's friend, whose life she threatens, and who later helps hold her captive.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Hope meets Cassie on the night Scott is freed from house arrest, and the three of them shrink down for a drive-in night together in a tiny car.
stages.whoA: Scott's daughter, whom she meets the night his house arrest ends.
stages.whoB: Her dad's partner, who joins them for a shrunken drive-in night.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Hope is part of Cassie's family now, alongside Scott, Hank and Janet. When Cassie's quantum satellite goes wrong, it pulls the whole family into the Quantum Realm.
stages.whoA: Family through Scott. Cassie's satellite pulls them all into the Quantum Realm.
stages.whoB: Family through her dad, pulled into the Quantum Realm with her.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Darcy is Jane Foster's assistant, and she tasers Thor the moment he lands on Earth. She is soon amused by the strange visitor as he stays with Jane's team in New Mexico.
stages.whoA: Jane's assistant, who tasers him the moment he lands on Earth.
stages.whoB: The stranger from the sky whom she tasers, then warms to.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Luis and the rest of Scott's old crew are brought into the heist on Pym Technologies over Hank's objections. Hope brings them coffee at the house they once robbed, and Luis remarks on how strange it is to be invited back.
stages.whoA: Scott's chatty old crewmate, brought into the heist on Pym Technologies.
stages.whoB: Hank's daughter and his partner in the heist on Pym Technologies.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Judge Renslayer sentences Loki to be pruned at his TVA trial, before Mobius takes him on to hunt a Loki variant. When the TVA's lies start to come apart, she turns on Mobius and prunes Loki herself as he speaks to Sylvie.
stages.whoA: The TVA judge who sentences him, then prunes him herself.
stages.whoB: The Loki variant she sentences at trial and later prunes herself.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha finds Selvig atop Stark Tower, freed from Loki's control, and tells him it is not his fault. He reveals the safeguard he built into his device, and she uses Loki's scepter to close the portal.
stages.whoA: Black Widow, who finds him freed and closes the portal with his safeguard.
stages.whoB: The scientist Loki controlled, whose safeguard lets her close the portal.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. team seizes all the research of Jane Foster's team, Selvig's included. Selvig then talks Coulson into releasing the stranger he is holding by passing him off as a staff member named Donald Blake.
stages.whoA: Jane's mentor, whose research he seizes and who lies to free Thor.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who seizes their research. He lies to him to free Thor.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Cosmo, a telepathic dog, joins the Guardians when they buy Knowhere. At Christmas she and Rocket decorate Groot like a tree, and when he drops his arms she complains that he ruined Christmas.
stages.whoA: A telepathic dog on the Guardians, who says he ruined Christmas.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian she and Rocket decorate like a Christmas tree.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Dum Dum Dugan is one of the Howling Commandos. He is freed from HYDRA's prison camp with the rest of the unit and fights with them across Europe under Steve Rogers.
stages.whoA: One of their own, the bowler hatted commando freed from HYDRA's camp.
stages.whoB: His unit, freed from the same HYDRA camp and fighting under Steve.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall lets the Warriors Three through the Bifrost when they follow Thor to Jotunheim. When Loki takes the throne, Heimdall calls them before him and lets them go to Earth to bring Thor home, defying Loki's orders.
stages.whoA: Thor's companions. He lets them go to Earth against Loki's orders.
stages.whoB: The Gatekeeper, who defies Loki to let them bring Thor home.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: At the Citadel at the End of Time, He Who Remains reveals that he has run the TVA all along and offers his place to Loki and Sylvie. Loki will not kill him, but Sylvie sends Loki back to the TVA and kills him.
stages.whoA: The man behind the TVA, who offers him and Sylvie his place.
stages.whoB: A Loki variant he means to have take his place.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Time slipping back to the Citadel, Loki learns that He Who Remains planned for it and wants Loki's help to keep the Sacred Timeline. Loki refuses, lets the past play out, and instead holds the branching timelines together himself.
stages.whoA: The man who planned his return. Loki refuses him and takes his place.
stages.whoB: The variant he counts on, who refuses him and takes his place.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Flash is a classmate on the academic decathlon team who keeps mocking Peter and Ned. At Liz's party he taunts them over Ned's claim that Peter knows Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: A classmate who keeps mocking him and Peter.
stages.whoB: Peter's best friend, whom he mocks along with Peter.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Detective Angie Kim reports to Mayor Fisk on the hunt for the Muse killer. Fisk presses her on whether Daredevil is back, then dismisses her.
stages.whoA: The mayor she reports to on the Muse case.
stages.whoB: The detective who briefs him on the Muse killer.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Kim is part of the resistance against Fisk's crackdown on vigilantes. She stands with Cherry and Mahoney when they march on the courthouse his task force is holding, and joins the crowd that storms it until Fisk is beaten.
stages.whoA: The mayor she now fights, until he is brought down.
stages.whoB: A detective in the resistance who storms the courthouse against him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Jim Morita is one of the Howling Commandos, and Peggy works with the unit in its war on HYDRA. He is in the radio room with her when Steve calls in from the HYDRA plane, until Colonel Phillips sends him out so she can speak to Steve alone.
stages.whoA: One of the Howling Commandos, at her side in the war on HYDRA.
stages.whoB: The SSR agent beside him in the war on HYDRA.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Steve is lost, Morita and Dum Dum Dugan follow Peggy on the raid that takes the last HYDRA base and captures Werner Reinhardt. There they agree that a permanent unit is needed to keep such dangerous technology contained.
stages.whoA: A commando who joins her raid on the last HYDRA base.
stages.whoB: The agent who leads him on the raid on HYDRA's last base.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: After the reporter Christine Everhart spends the night with Tony, Pepper hands back her cleaned clothes and sees her out. The two trade insults, and Pepper says her job includes taking out the trash.
stages.whoA: A reporter who spends the night with Tony. Pepper shows her out.
stages.whoB: Tony's assistant, who hands back her clothes and shows her out.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner bring Vision to life by uploading what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into a synthetic body, and Vision fights beside Tony against Ultron.
stages.whoA: J.A.R.V.I.S. reborn, whom he helps bring to life.
stages.whoB: One of his creators, beside whom he fights Ultron.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision sides with Tony over the Sokovia Accords and fights for him at the Leipzig airport.
stages.whoA: An ally on his side of the Accords at Leipzig.
stages.whoB: The leader he sides with over the Accords.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Bruce Banner helps Tony Stark upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body that becomes Vision. Vision then fights beside him as a fellow Avenger.
stages.whoA: The synthetic being he helps create, now a fellow Avenger.
stages.whoB: One of his creators, now a fellow Avenger.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha and Steve Rogers train Vision as part of the new Avengers after Sokovia.
stages.whoA: A new Avenger she helps train after Sokovia.
stages.whoB: One of the Avengers who train him after Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos's Black Order comes for the Mind Stone, Natasha fights to protect Vision in Edinburgh and Wakanda.
stages.whoA: A teammate she fights to protect from the Black Order.
stages.whoB: A teammate who fights to protect him from the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: T'Challa and his people protect Vision in Wakanda while Shuri works on the Mind Stone.
stages.whoA: Wakanda's king, who protects him while Shuri works.
stages.whoB: The android he protects in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos sends the Black Order after the Mind Stone in Vision's head. When Wanda destroys the Stone to stop him, Thanos turns back time with the Time Stone, rips it from Vision's head and kills him.
stages.whoA: The Titan who rips the Mind Stone from his head and kills him.
stages.whoB: The android he kills to take the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Monica Rambeau is Maria Rambeau's daughter, a bright young girl who idolizes her mother's best friend Carol Danvers.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, a bright girl who idolizes Carol Danvers.
stages.whoB: Her mother, a pilot and Carol Danvers' best friend.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Maria dies of cancer while Monica is gone in the Blip, and Monica comes back to find her mother lost.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, who is gone in the Blip when Maria dies of cancer.
stages.whoB: Her mother, who dies of cancer while Monica is gone in the Blip.
